title: TaskReport
description: Standardized completion report emitted by autonomous worker agents upon task completion.

task_id.description: Unique identifier for the task, typically matching the worktree directory name.

status.description: Final execution status of the task.

summary.description: A concise, high-level summary of what was implemented or resolved.

files_modified.description: List of existing files modified during the task.

files_created.description: List of new files created during the task.

tests_run.description: Commands or test suites executed to verify the implementation.

tests_passed.description: True if all test suites exited with code 0.

git_commit.description: The git commit hash created on the task branch.

notes.description: Additional notes, edge cases handled, or follow-up suggestions for the Watcher.
